questions.question: Why does the wise teacher say not to envy wicked men or want their company?

answers.text: Their hearts are full of pride

questions.question: In the proverb about a house built by wisdom, what fills its rooms through knowledge?

answers.text: Tools for every kind of work

questions.question: According to the wise teacher, what does a righteous man do when he falls seven times?
The wise teacher warns against gloating when your enemy falls. What might the LORD do if He sees it?

answers.text: He would turn His wrath away from your enemy
He would make you fall the very same way
He would raise your enemy up above you
